description: Premium gourmet burger delivery landing page and digital menu with WhatsApp ordering.

typography.instructions: Use Bebas Neue for all main headings (Hero, Section titles, Product names) with tight tracking (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter). Use Manrope for descriptions, prices, and UI elements. Never use generic sans-serif for headings.

colors.instructions: Use deep black (#050505) for main backgrounds to make the food photography pop. Use #121212 for product cards. The primary CTA color is an appetizing Red-Orange (#FF4500), and WhatsApp green for the final checkout action.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) on cards and surfaces.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle ambient shadows. Focus mostly on lighting and contrast rather than heavy drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle noise/grain overlay (opacity 0.03) over the entire app to give a premium, tactile restaurant feel.
visual_enhancers.radii: Use rounded-3xl (24px) for product images and large cards. Use pill-shape (rounded-full) for primary CTA buttons.

layouts.hero: Asymmetric hero section. Large typography on the left (or top on mobile) and a massive, overlapping burger image on the right (or bottom on mobile) that breaks the container. The burger should look like it's floating.
layouts.categories: Horizontal scrollable flex container (hide scrollbar) with pill-shaped category toggles.
layouts.menu_grid: Bento-style grid. Featured items can span 2 columns. Standard items are 1 column. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6.
layouts.cart_drawer: Use Shadcn Sheet component. Slides from the right on desktop, bottom on mobile. Contains cart items, observation textarea, delivery fee calculation, and total.

motion.hero: Smooth floating animation on the main burger image (y-axis translation). Entrance animations on text with staggered Framer Motion.
motion.cards: Hover states on menu items: slight scale up (scale-105) of the product image and button appears or changes color.
motion.cart: Sticky floating bottom bar on mobile indicating 'View Cart (X items) - $XX.XX' that animates in when items are added.

component_instructions.Header: Glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/50) with 1px bottom border. Contains text logo 'Ricardo ZapDelivery' and cart icon.
component_instructions.ProductCard: Flat surface (#121212) with subtle white border. Image takes top half. Bottom half has title, description (line-clamp-2), price, and an 'Add' icon button.
component_instructions.Cart: Shadcn Sheet. Include input for delivery address, a textarea for 'Observações', a static/dynamic delivery fee row, and a large 'Finalizar no WhatsApp' button.

hero_burger.description: High quality burger with lettuce and tomato on dark background

menu_sides.description: Crunchy french fries on black surface

menu_drinks.description: Bottle of coca cola with ice

whatsapp_integration.instructions: When finalizing the order, encode a WhatsApp URL like: `https://wa.me/5512988043993?text={URL_ENCODED_MESSAGE}`. The message should nicely format the items, total price, delivery fee, address, and observations.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centralized layouts. Embrace asymmetry for the hero.
Ensure the layout is highly mobile-optimized. A floating 'View Cart' sticky bottom bar is mandatory on mobile when items are in cart.
Do not use generic sans-serif for headings (use Bebas Neue).
Add hover animations to all interactive elements.
Use framer-motion for page entrances and the hero floating burger.
Make sure text has sufficient contrast against dark backgrounds.
Implement data-testid on all interactive elements.
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide icons for UI icons (cart, plus, minus, trash, whatsapp).
